top_stories.title: Waste treatment plants will soon turn wealth generating units, says MA&UD Minister Narayana - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **P. Narayana**, Minister for Municipal Administration and Urban Development, announced that **Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu** has approved the establishment of 107 waste processing units across the state by July, with an estimated ₹300 crore investment.  The initiative aims to address legacy waste in areas like the Donthali dumping yard in Nellore Rural, where a Jindal group-led waste-to-energy plant is being constructed.

top_stories.title: 4,800 illegal infiltrators deported to Bangladesh, says Bengal CM Suvendu - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, West Bengal Chief Minister, announced that **4,800** individuals deported from India to Bangladesh over the past month were not covered by the Citizenship (Amendment) Act. He stated that these individuals were handed over to the **Border Security Force** under a law used in other states but not applied in West Bengal, where they were treated as guests and lodged in prisons.

top_stories.title: CM seeks cooperation of parties cutting across political lines in the development of the city - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** urged the **BJP** and **BRS** to cooperate in developing the state capital as a global city, urging them to put aside political differences for the benefit of the people.  He criticized **Union Minister G. Kishan Reddy**, accusing him of "hobnobbing" with **BRS working president K.T. Rama Rao** and hindering project approvals from the central government.

top_stories.title: West Bengal Government to provide jobs to kin of BJP workers killed in 2021 post-poll violence - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, West Bengal Chief Minister, announced that the state government will provide jobs to the families of 315 deceased **BJP** workers from the post-election violence of 2021.  He also stated that one-time financial assistance of ₹5 lakh would be provided to all affected families through the **Chief Minister’s Relief Fund**.

top_stories.title: Eggs thrown at Trinamool leaders, workers as public anger mounts in Bengal - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Trinamool Congress** (TMC) MLA Madan Mitra was targeted by public anger over accusations of corruption. On Saturday night, June 6, 2026, eggs were thrown at his convoy in Kamarhati constituency. The incident has sparked further public discontent and highlighted the ongoing tension between citizens and local party workers following the TMC's defeat in the 2026 West Bengal Assembly election.

top_stories.title: After TMC MLAs, MPs may be next: Mamata lands in Delhi amid fears of a repeat in Parliament | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, the **TMC** chief, arrived in Delhi to meet with **Arvind Kejriwal** and discuss the future of the INDIA bloc.  She is facing a potential split within her party as some MPs are reportedly dissatisfied with **Abhishek Banerjee**, the parliamentary party leader. Sources indicate that a section of MPs may approach Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla on Monday, while others are in contact with him to explore options. The rebels have confidence that 20 MPs will join them, but **Mamata** believes at least 16 MPs will remain loyal to her.

top_stories.title: Techie loses 4.76 lakh after clicking fake traffic challan link; fraudsters buy 4 high-end phones | Pune News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A 30-year-old techie from Alandi, working for an IT company, fell victim to a remote access scam after clicking on a fake traffic challan link. **The fraudsters** swiftly spent Rs 4.76 lakh from his bank account within minutes to purchase four high-end phones.  **Police** are investigating the case and have launched a probe into the address used by the criminals.  Experts warn users to avoid installing apps from unknown links and verify government alerts through official channels.

top_stories.title: Neutralise miscreants if found roaming with weapons in civilian areas of Manipur: CRPF DG - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)** Director General G.P. Singh urged personnel deployed in Manipur to "neutralize" individuals carrying weapons in civilian areas during a meeting on Saturday.  Singh stated that these discussions were held at the highest levels of government and that he expects a turnaround in the situation within 1-1.5 years.

top_stories.title: India, Indonesia discuss PM Modi’s Jakarta visit, deepen cooperation in defence, maritime security | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **S Jaishankar** and **Sugiono**, the Indonesian Foreign Minister, co-chaired the 8th India-Indonesia Joint Commission Meeting in New Delhi on Sunday. The two leaders discussed strengthening cooperation in defense, maritime security, digital connectivity, infrastructure, trade, and people-to-people exchanges. They also agreed to deepen ties through a possible visit by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to Jakarta next month.  The meeting reaffirmed the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership between the two nations, which was bolstered by discussions between President Prabowo Subianto and **PM Modi**.

top_stories.title: Nitin Nabin instructs BJP cadre in Jharkhand to gear up for 2029 Assembly election - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nitin Nabin**, the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** national president, addressed party workers in Jharkhand on June 7, 2026, urging them to prepare for the 2029 Assembly election. He emphasized that the state remains a stronghold and urged workers to learn from past elections, focusing on rebuilding trust and engaging booth-level workers. **Nabin** directed regular meetings at all levels, including district offices, to maintain communication with grassroots workers and address shortcomings.  He also stressed the importance of veteran worker reintegration and coordination between senior and junior members.
